name: cfg-provider-context-window
about: contextWindow=30000 作为 maxContextTokens 的别名（parseModelConfig.ts:281-285）：agent.model 指向该模型且不配 agent.maxContextTokens，context_budget 的总量取 30000。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: cwp/cw
model:
  providers:
    cwp:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        cw:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
            contextWindow: 30000
telemetry:
  enabled: false
